label: The customers' queued work, prepared
description: What jobs.port.json means under every profile: ensure the broker jobs.connection.json reaches. It is the one binding of the port, so every profile reaches it; only the production profiles' startup fires it, since there jobs.connection.json stands for the customer database and the queue is a table, and the in-process broker the laptop's profiles keep has nothing to create.

prepare.description: Create the queue table on the connection where the broker keeps one, and leave it alone where it is there.
